skill.universal_tool.counter_guard.desc: Deploy an aegis that deflects all incoming projectiles; if damage is taken, completely negate it and reflect it back to the attacker.
skill.universal_tool.gravity_well.desc: Create a black hole at the targeted point lasting 5 to 11 seconds, continuously pulling enemies within 28 to 36 blocks toward its core. Higher levels increase both the radius and duration.
skill.universal_tool.frozen_pull.desc: Pull the target you aim at in front of you and freeze it for 5-7 seconds. It cannot move, attack, or use abilities and takes fixed damage equal to 4% of its maximum health every 0.5 seconds.
skill.universal_tool.oppressive_field.de: Inflict Weakness III within 12/15/18 blocks for 6/8/10 seconds. Gain 20% damage reduction for the same duration, or 40% at max rank.
skill.universal_tool.ore_sight.desc: Sense nearby ores for 10 seconds with cyan location markers visible through stone. Markers near the crosshair display distance.
skill.universal_tool.air_step.desc: Hold the cast key in midair to keep propelling along your view for up to 1/2/3 seconds. Release or reach the time limit to finish and start cooldown.
unlock.counter_guard: Unlock: defeat attackers shortly after they hit you.
unlock.oppressive_field: Unlock: win against several enemies at once.
